subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should the legacy no-code orphan diagnostic case be accepted as a runtime stale-registry invalidation path once proof is added, or should that cleanup move to doctor/migration?
rationale: The explicit marker follows prior maintainer direction, but the no-code legacy branch intentionally changes upgrade behavior for persisted SQLite diagnostics that lack the new marker.

options.title: Require Proof, Then Accept Runtime Fallback
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head proof of a pre-code SQLite row rederiving and Gateway startup proceeding, then land the runtime fallback if that proof matches the tests.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers may waive external proof and accept the current source, tests, and CI as enough for this upgrade-sensitive path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Pause this PR and move no-code persisted diagnostic cleanup to the migration/doctor owner instead of changing runtime stale detection.

recommendation.title: Require Proof, Then Accept Runtime Fallback
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head proof of a pre-code SQLite row rederiving and Gateway startup proceeding, then land the runtime fallback if that proof matches the tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and has recent ownership signals in the plugin discovery/registry surface.
